summary: Custom modules can be enabled by putting them in any directory listed in ANSIBLE_LIBRARY (colon-separated), ~/.ansible/plugins/modules/ or /usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules/.
questions: Where can I put a custom module so all my playbooks can use it?
How do I add multiple directories for custom modules?

answer_card.title: Where to install custom modules
answer_card.answer_md:
Place custom modules in any of:
- a directory in `ANSIBLE_LIBRARY` (colon-separated, like `$PATH`)
- `~/.ansible/plugins/modules/`
- `/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules/`
